integrity: The proof is analytic. The exterior-square identity and Bell-subspace realization are stated explicitly, and finite computation is not used as a substitute for an infinite-dimensional or all-n argument.
limitations: The theorem determines the exact rank-two radial signature spectrum for the local-Z tuple, not the full vector range for n>=4, other ranks, or larger Pauli error families. Full text of the 2018 Pauli-classification article was not available in the inspected lawful sources, leaving a residual risk of an equivalent formula under different notation.
title: Exact rank-two signature spectrum for local Pauli \(Z\) observables
